name: Support escalation
description: When a support ticket comes in, summarize it with AI, let a human agent review and edit the reply, escalate to the support channel, and email the customer back.

requiredCredentials.name: support_slack
requiredCredentials.purpose: Escalates the ticket to your support channel

requiredOrgConfigs.purpose: Sender address used to reply to the customer

config.prompt:
You are a support assistant. Summarize this ticket in 2 sentences and draft a polite reply (under 150 words). Do not invent product features. Subject: {{context.trigger.output.subject}}

Message: {{context.trigger.output.message}}

config.title: Review the support reply before it goes out
config.description: Edit the drafted reply if needed and approve to send it to the customer.

finalReply.description: Final reply body. Pre-filled from the AI draft; edit as needed.

input.subject: Locked out after password reset
input.message: I reset my password an hour ago and now the app says my account doesn't exist. Please help — I have a deadline today.

failureFixtures.label: Escalation post timed out
failureFixtures.description: The support-channel notification exceeds its bounded request timeout before the customer reply is sent.

errorJson.name: ToolError
errorJson.message: slack.post failed: request timed out after 30000ms
